chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Hadeed, from Jameel, from Zurara who said:
I asked one of the two (peace be upon them) about the Imam being responsible for the prayer of the people. He said: No.

key_terms.أَحَدَهُمَا: one of the two (referring to the 5th or 6th Imam)

ai.seo_question: Is the Imam responsible for the validity of the congregation's prayer?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi through the chain of Zurarah, a key companion of the Imams, this hadith clarifies the legal principle of individual accountability in congregational prayer. It establishes that the Imam’s role is to lead and recite, but he does not bear personal liability (ضمان) for the validity of the followers' prayers, reinforcing the Shia view that each worshipper must ensure their own ritual correctness.
